canDo: Can propose real conditions and hypothetical advice, and explain why each piece of advice works.
review: Review the conditionnel and cause/effect; learn si + présent/futur and si + imparfait/conditionnel systematically.
input: Listening and reading on health and study habits.
output: Write 140 words of advice; give 4 pieces of advice aloud in 3 minutes.
checkpoint: Write/say at least 4 condition–result pairs; never use the conditionnel directly in the si clause.
challenge: Today’s challenge: observe your own routine for a week (sleep, exercise, food); write 3 pieces of realistic advice with si + présent → futur and 2 hypothetical ones with si + imparfait → conditionnel; then find a health exercise on TV5MONDE Apprendre to check your vocabulary.

questions.why: The physiological reason given is that “the internal clock lengthens more easily than it shortens”. Rotating shifts forward doesn’t reduce the number of night shifts.
« Beaucoup essaient de dormir en rentrant, échouent, puis abandonnent » — the other two options are the advice itself.
Skipping the night meal leads to snacking around four in the morning, exactly when digestion works least well.
« la familiarité n'est pas la mémoire » — the exam asks you to produce, not to recognise.
The text says clearly: good immediate results, poor delayed ones, because the step of “choosing the method” was never practised.
He stresses a minimum plan you can stick to “even in a bad week”, without changing the route or the time.
The mechanism given is that blinking less causes dryness, plus the focusing muscles staying fixed for a long time.
Lowering the screen reduces how much of the eye is exposed, which eases dryness; relaxing the focusing muscles is what “looking into the distance for twenty seconds” does.
The biggest spending is ready meals and drinks, almost half — not vegetables.
Dried pulses replace part of the meat; the three reasons for frozen vegetables are the same nutrition, a stable price all year and no waste.
« perdre le contrat, c'est perdre la formation » — tuition fees are an issue for the full-time route.
Most people underestimate their usage by about a third; seeing the exact figure has a real effect in the first few weeks.
« se vérifie tout de suite » contrasted with « se discute chaque soir avec soi-même ».
Both medicines contain paracetamol, so taking them together means an overdose without realising it.
Keep the cold medicine and use the same tablets for the headache, six hours apart.
« il entretient l'obstruction qu'il est censé soulager » — it doesn’t just stop working.
